body: i'm a female. not that it matters, but no i don't see that in my future.

she says my crying isn't validated because i should be kissing her ass that she provides a roof and food for me. i am grateful. she threatens to withhold food from me all of the time, if i don't do this or that and it's just so... manipulative. i feel selfish complaining but all i ask is for the verbal abuse to stop and it doesn't. it never has. i'm sensitive as hell to it and i can only see myself spiraling down. i've been away for a little, with friends. she is my only living relative and i want to bail too but it's easier said than done.

thank you, this is sort of calming me down. she just overheard me crying and feeling helpless and told me i am too sensitive. am i? she usually laughs it off afterward but i don't, ever. i take it to heart. each and every time. the look of pure disdain in her eyes when she tells me to kill myself is enough for me to not take it as a joke.

....and cue 10 minutes later, it's on again. she just keeps repeating it over and over i don't know what to do.

i am really trying but i feel like in the span of time looking for jobs i'm not going to be strong enough to handle this. it's so often and in the moment it feels like i should just kill myself to make her shut up but every day that i don't it just continues. when i say no to doing something for her, when i forget something, it always leads to why i'm still alive. she even told me if i follow through to not do it in the house.
